issues.description: The template uses the incorrect register identifier 'ecc' (add eax, ecc) while the problem statement and the solution refer to the correct register name 'ecx'. This typo in the template creates a naming mismatch for the same conceptual entity (the ECX register) and may confuse students trying to map the instructions to the starter code.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the incorrect identifier 'ecc' with the correct register name 'ecx' in the template file (change 'add eax, ecc' to 'add eax, ecx') so the template, problem statement, and solution consistently reference the same register.
